subject.title: feat(openclaw): support pinning release version via openclaw_version

question: Should the Ansible installer officially support exact OpenClaw version pins and automatic development-to-release binary cleanup, while preserving `latest` as the default?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and has real behavior proof, but it adds an operator-facing configuration and changes the supported release-update and mode-transition contract; correctness alone cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in pinning
options.body: Accept `openclaw_version` with `latest` as the unchanged default and treat the documented binary cleanup as the supported development-to-release migration path.

options.title: Keep rolling latest only
options.body: Retain the current release-mode policy of always installing `@latest` and decline the new configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in pinning
recommendation.body: Accept `openclaw_version` with `latest` as the unchanged default and treat the documented binary cleanup as the supported development-to-release migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available owner for the release-policy choice, although direct ownership of the installer path could not be confirmed from available history.
